name: golukituki-workspace
description: A geography location-guessing game, starting with South Korea.

scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @golukituki/core build && corepack pnpm --filter @golukituki/web build && corepack pnpm --filter @golukituki/worker build
scripts.dev: corepack pnpm --filter @golukituki/web build && concurrently --kill-others --names worker,web --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "corepack pnpm --filter @golukituki/worker dev" "corepack pnpm --filter @golukituki/web dev"
scripts.validate: corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm build
scripts.deploy:preview: corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm --filter @golukituki/worker deploy:preview
scripts.deploy:production: corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm --filter @golukituki/worker deploy:production
